# Release Status

This is the canonical editable QMD source for the UpstreamDrift engineering
design manual. It is a governance scaffold, not a released engineering manual.
The calculation inventory is empty and release remains blocked by UP-D1 through
UP-D8. No generated HTML, LaTeX, PDF, or DOCX artifact is approved.
